tasks.label: WasteDeal: setup environment
tasks.command: $pythonLauncher = if (Get-Command py -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { 'py' } else { 'python' }; if (-not (Test-Path '.venv\Scripts\python.exe')) { & $pythonLauncher -m venv .venv; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE } }; & .\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -c "import flask" 2>$null; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { & .\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pip install -r requirements.txt; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE } }
